title: 菜单上的英文
title_py: cài dān shàng de yīng wén

lines.text: 小周工作的饭店是一家川菜馆，最近外国客人越来越多，老板就做了一份中英文菜单。
lines.py: Xiǎo Zhōu gōng zuò de fàn diàn shì yì jiā chuān cài guǎn, zuì jìn wài guó kè rén yuè lái yuè duō, lǎo bǎn jiù zuò le yí fèn zhōng yīng wén cài dān.
lines.en: Xiao Zhou works at a Sichuan restaurant. Lately more and more foreign customers have been coming in, so the owner has made a menu in Chinese and English.
